summary_1line: Krishna explains cosmic cycles, the paths after death, and reveals the royal knowledge that devotion to him transcends rituals and leads to liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A cosmic vision shows countless beings emerging from darkness at Brahma’s dawn and dissolving back into the unmanifest at night.
Krishna reveals himself as the universe itself—sun, rain, fire, and sacrifice—while Arjuna listens in awe on the battlefield.
A humble devotee offers a single leaf and a cup of water to Krishna, who accepts it with serene grace.
